description: Represents a section title / heading as ONE heading block, carrying its nesting level and its parent heading, so the document's heading tree can be reconstructed.
applicability: The region is a title or heading: a document title, a chapter/section/subsection heading, or a titled sub-heading.
Headings form a hierarchy (title > chapter > section > subsection).
instructions: Emit each heading as ONE block of block_type heading. In its content include a `level` (integer; 1 = the top/document title, increasing for deeper headings) and the heading text.

Set parent_block_id to the nearest ENCLOSING heading of a higher level (a subsection's parent is its section); a top-level heading has parent_block_id null. Only headings parent other headings here — do NOT parent body paragraphs to headings.
Infer level from the structural hierarchy (font weight/size, numbering depth like 1 / 1.1 / 1.1.1), not from text length.
Keep the heading text as one block; do NOT merge a heading with the paragraph beneath it, and do NOT split a multi-line heading.
A heading is never a table, figure, caption, or body paragraph.

provenance.reason: General-document adaptation (MPDocBench): headings and their nesting are scored by HeadTEDS, so a heading carries an explicit level and a heading-only parent.
